ctx.x: How long did you play the Savoy before you went on the road?

Well, we only played there about a week. I think (inaudible) just to reset the band, and add Bill Beeson to the band. And reset some of the arrangements, you know. Chick wasn't with us anymore so we had to reset his solos. I mean take out and add. You know, just reset the whole routine of what we're going to play.
